scope: Read-only independent method review of frozen common_pair_P_release. No simulation, controller execution, parameter search or traffic metric recalculation. P100/C1_P analysis belongs to the separate formal evaluation.

local_information.input: Same private local physical tracks in ego[-100,+200]m; own pending_lane only. No other vehicle intention, true SUMO ID, global rank, shared slot assignment or central schedule enters the rules.
local_information.complete_head_search_bound: A peer within±50m, its reverse-nearest candidates within another±50m, and their forward50m head tests require only ego[-100,+150]m, contained in the declared sensor window.
local_information.identity: Private tracks are compared for identity/gap continuity; head order uses projected geometric error and physical x,y,v,vy, not ID priority. The rules import only dataclasses and sqrt.
local_information.geometry: drop_x and the existing360m preparation distance are road geometry already available to H. P adds no demand-flow threshold, timer, new gain or memory state. The50m formation link is distinct from200m safety sensing and from existing90m local helper/fill geometry.

pair_geometry.rule: With a boundary, pair_lanes=2 iff max(car.lane,peer.lane)<2 and min(car.x,peer.x)>=boundary; otherwise3. With boundaryNone, retain supplied lane count.
pair_geometry.dispatch: Transform uses drop_x−360m; ordinary formation uses actual drop_x; straight road has no boundary. nearest ordering and the applied error both call the same _pair_error, including pair-specific denominator max(1,pair_lanes−1).
pair_geometry.corrected_counterexample: The archived P_ending_lane_geometry_audit concerns calibration d72154c2, which returned a two-lane zero error for an actually measured lane2/1 pair after640m, while three-lane error was15m. Release8d112d79 adds the lane-scope guard; its saved scope log records two RED failures then two GREEN passes. Old calibration results remain bound to d72154c2.
pair_geometry.static_reciprocity: The boundary predicate is symmetric in the two measured cars. With the same boundary, raw_pair_error(a,b) is the negative of raw_pair_error(b,a), and both obtain the same pair lane count/weight.
pair_geometry.claim_limit: This is a pair-definition fact, not a whole-system zero-sum or stability theorem. Actual head eligibility, lane-range loops, executing/receiving branches, nearest switches, safety clipping and entry/exit can differ. Ending-lane and retained cars need not actually execute reciprocal phase commands on the same frame.

measured_lane_scope_limit.fact: The ending-lane guard tests measured car.lane, not _occupies(car,2) and not strict lane-change completion. SUMO lane index can flip near the lateral midpoint while the vehicle still straddles the old lane.
measured_lane_scope_limit.allowed_statement: Every pair containing a car whose measured lane index is2 keeps three-lane pair geometry.
measured_lane_scope_limit.unsupported_statement: Pair geometry remains three-lane until the entire body has physically exited lane2 or the lane change is fully completed.
measured_lane_scope_limit.physical_projection: For each fixed pair lane count, _physical_phase uses measured y continuously and agrees with discrete phase at lane centers. The common discrete3→2 switch, graph membership and lane-index eligibility can still switch; full-controller continuity is not established.

following_and_safety.body: An actual front within50m is followed at front.x−30 using front.speed; no body phase, rear assistance or cruise reset is added to that branch. Outside a local front link, a head uses the existing cruise reference and bounded phase contribution.
following_and_safety.excluded_failed_terms: No N positive-rear reference assistance; no J spatial phase field; no K spatial Jacobian/velocity correction. _phase/_physical_phase and _request remain H/E11 definitions.
following_and_safety.shared_execution: Engine6a5300 and shared safe_speed, _clear, target-lane guard, own-pending lifecycle and vehicle physics are unchanged from H/E11. Insertion reserve remains max(8,4+1.5+.2*v_rear+max(v_rear²−v_incoming²,0)/20), distinct from final30m formation spacing.
following_and_safety.physics: tau.2,minGap1.5,accel5,decel10,emergencyDecel30,maxSpeed33.3,dt.1. All modes share native execution constraints. No global safety theorem follows from the formula; formal safety/completion audit is still required.

saved_functional_evidence_only.interpretation: The scrambled case demonstrates formation in that small scene; the original already-organized case demonstrates transformation/recovery. Neither establishes continuous-flow traffic benefit or whole-fleet formation coverage.

formal_claim_requirements: Bind all P100 observations to release8d112d79, not calibrationd72154c2; keep held-out seeds6–10 distinct from calibration seeds1/4.

Same-source NOA, straight/drop differences, fixed640–1100m segment measures, low-speed accumulation/flow, fuel and source audits must decide traffic claims. This method review supplies no new P100 result.

Use same-overtaking C1_P as the explicitly source-bound strategy ablation. With weak upstream complete formation, ordinary cooperative merging or local spacing regulation must not be described as proven benefit of preformed full multilayer platoons.
Preserve negative/mixed E/J/K/N/P-calibration outcomes and uncompleted/execution failures; do not fit all E1–E7 failures into the same three mechanisms.
verdict: No new privileged information path or weakened shared guard found. The release corrects the documented measured-lane2 pair-scope defect while preserving local H body following. Static geometric consistency and the saved six-car checks are valid limited facts; global stability, full-occupancy phase gating and traffic improvement remain unproven by this review.
